data.title: Contribution increase notice from Musterquell Krankenkasse

change.quote: ab dem 01.01.2027 betragen Ihre monatlichen Beiträge 318,46 €.

data.explanation: Your monthly contribution to statutory health and long-term care insurance (Kranken- und Pflegeversicherung) as a voluntarily insured member is rising to €318.46 from 1 January 2027, because of a new supplementary contribution rate and the income shown on your 2025 tax assessment. The amount will keep being debited automatically on the 15th of the following month. If you disagree with the increase, you may file a written objection (Widerspruch) with Musterquell Krankenkasse — the app shows the deadline by which it must arrive. If you do nothing, the new amount simply applies and is debited as described.

items.title: File an objection (Widerspruch) against the contribution increase
items.action: If you disagree with the new contribution amount, submit a written objection (or declare it to the record) to Musterquell Krankenkasse by the deadline shown.
items.quote: Den Widerspruch können Sie binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Musterquell Krankenkasse, Am Brunnenhof 2, 35390 Mustergießen.

items.title: Pay the increased monthly health insurance contribution
items.action: Make sure sufficient funds are available for the automatic debit (Lastschrift) of your contribution.
items.quote: Wir buchen den Beitrag weiter zum 15. des Folgemonats ab.

data.summary: Musterquell Krankenkasse notifies Johanna Beispielacker that her monthly voluntary health and long-term care insurance contributions will rise to €318.46 from 1 January 2027, due to a new supplementary contribution rate and the income shown on her 2025 tax assessment. The amount continues to be debited on the 15th of the following month, and the letter includes instructions for filing an objection (Widerspruch).
data.tax_note: Contributions to statutory health and long-term care insurance are generally deductible as special expenses (Sonderausgaben) in the German income tax return, so keep this notice for your records.
